calendar.matters:
ORDER TO SHOW CAUSE FOR CHANGE OF NAME
Off Calendar Nov-01-2007 Granted Per Written Order
MINI MINUTES: This cause came on regularly as scheduled for OSC hearing for Change of Name of an Adult and of a Minor.
Dept. 218, Commissioner: Sue Kaplan, Clerk: S. Ravinantapricha, CSR: Denise Doucette.
Petitioner: Zhao Hui Zou, present in pro per for self and as Guardian ad litem for the Minor: Zhen Yu Zou.
Co-Petitioner/Minor's Mother: Shao Huan Chen, also present in court with Cantonese Interpreter: Lihong Tan.
Petitioner were sworn and examined.
No objections to the proposed change of name of the Minor were made at the hearing.
It appears to the satisfaction of the Court that all the allegations in the petition are true, correct, and sufficient and that the petition should be granted.
The Court grants the petition for Change of Name of an Adult to:Sam Zhaohui Zou, and grants the petition for Change of Name of a Minor to: Jeffrey Zhenyu Zou..
Decree signed in open court.
